# CrowdFXLabs

> CrowdFXLabs creates real-time interactive experiences that turn live audiences into active participants in shared, large-screen experiences.

<!-- TODO: Replace every kalinaborkiewicz.com/crowdfxlabs URL when the permanent production domain is available. -->
Canonical website: https://kalinaborkiewicz.com/crowdfxlabs/
Contact: kalina.borkiewicz@acmsiggraph.org

## What CrowdFXLabs does

- Collaborative crowd games for live audiences
- Live audience polling
- Participatory visual art shaped by audience input
- Custom real-time interactions for large screens and live events

## Key facts

- Experiences are designed for rooms with thousands of people.
- Attendees do not need to download an app.
- Individual audience responses become a shared visual experience.
- CrowdFXLabs projects emphasize immediate, collective participation.
